meta.title: Kampung Sumber Alam · Stay and soak in hot spring water in Cipanas, Garut
meta.desc: Kampung Sumber Alam Resort is a Sundanese village in Cipanas, Garut. You stay in a timber bungalow over a fish pond and soak in natural Mount Guntur hot spring water in your own room.
hero.sub: Kampung Sumber Alam Resort · Cipanas, Garut
video.label: Kampung Sumber Alam seen from the air
pembuka.lead: Hot springs flow at the foot of Mount Guntur, in Garut. That water is the heart of Kampung Sumber Alam, a resort laid out as a Sundanese village, and today it runs all the way to the soaking tub in every bungalow's bathroom.
//pembuka.lead.lengkap: Awaiting KSA confirmation ("for generations"): The hot springs at the foot of Mount Guntur, in Garut, have flowed for generations. That water is the heart of Kampung Sumber Alam, a resort laid out as a Sundanese village, and today it runs all the way to the soaking tub in every bungalow's bathroom.
cerita.label: The story of Kampung Sumber Alam
cerita.judul: Why do the bungalows at Kampung Sumber Alam stand over fish ponds?
cerita.1.judul: Kampung Sumber Alam built its bungalows over the balong, so the balong is still here today.
cerita.1.isi: Balong is the Sundanese word for a fish pond, and Kampung Sumber Alam has kept its ponds from disappearing. The thatched timber bungalows were built over the water.
//cerita.1.isi.lengkap: Awaiting KSA approval (neighbours' use of the water): Balong is the Sundanese word for a fish pond, and Kampung Sumber Alam has kept its ponds from disappearing. The thatched timber bungalows were built over the water, and people living around Kampung Sumber Alam still use that water to raise fish, to bathe and to wash.
cerita.1.alt: A winding timber walkway over a lily-covered balong between thatched houses, seen from the air
cerita.2.judul: Kampung Sumber Alam measures itself by how you feel during your stay, not by how many facilities it has.
cerita.2.isi: Your body feels fresh again once warm water has loosened it. Your mood lifts when you are welcomed sincerely and have time again for the people you came with. That is why Kampung Sumber Alam arranges its rooms, pools and food so that every guest feels comfortable, sincerely looked after, and close again to the people they came with.
cerita.3.judul: Kampung Sumber Alam greets you with “Wilujeng Sumping”.
cerita.3.isi: “Wilujeng Sumping” means welcome in Sundanese. From the Lobby you walk to your room along a footpath between the balong and the gardens, and the farthest room is only ±250 m from the Lobby.
cerita.3.alt: Two guests pull their luggage along a path towards a thatched timber bungalow
cerita.4.judul: Hot spring water from Mount Guntur loosens your body.
cerita.4.isi: The best time to soak is from sunset into the night. As the lights come on in the timber houses, you fill the tub in your own bathroom with natural hot spring water from Mount Guntur. Kolam Renang Tasik Madu, the main pool, and Kamar Rendam, a private room for a 25-minute soak, draw on the same source. Guests of Kamar Rendam are served warm bandrek or bajigur, two Sundanese spiced drinks, after their soak.
cerita.4.alt: Three thatched timber houses with lit windows over the balong at night, and a lantern on the timber walkway
cerita.5.isi: In the morning you wake in a room above a balong covered in lily pads. Breakfast is included in the room rate and check-out is not until 12 noon, so there is time for one more soak with your family, your partner or your colleagues before you leave.
cerita.5.alt: A fountain in the balong, thatched bungalows, and Mount Guntur in the distance
cerita.coda.isi: Kampung Sumber Alam calls itself a Sundanese Thermal Escape Village: a Sundanese village where people slip away from routine to soak in natural hot spring water from Mount Guntur. Kampung Sumber Alam invites you to take a short rest, soak with the people you brought, and go home refreshed.
berendam.judul: You can soak in hot spring water in four places
berendam.pengantar: The pool, the soaking rooms and the tubs here share one source: natural hot spring water from Mount Guntur.
berendam.1.nama: The hot tub in your room
berendam.1.isi: You soak in your own bathroom, in the morning before breakfast or at night before bed.
berendam.2.isi: You soak for 25 minutes in a private room, then drink a warm bandrek or bajigur (Sundanese ginger and palm-sugar drinks). Kamar Rendam costs Rp50,000 per 25 minutes.
berendam.3.isi: This public swimming pool is filled with natural hot spring water and sits behind the Lobby.
berendam.4.isi: Villa Sibentang guests soak in natural hot spring water in their own villa's private pool.
menginap.judul: Rooms at Kampung Sumber Alam sleep two to 18 guests.
menginap.p: Kampung Sumber Alam has 80 rooms in 14 types, including two Villa Sibentang types. From any room, a short walk along the footpaths between the gardens and the balong takes you to Kolam Renang Tasik Madu, the restaurants or the Lobby.
menginap.foto1: Kawung has two floors, with a floor-seating (lesehan) lounge downstairs.
menginap.foto2: Pondok Kalapa is a single-storey bungalow, ±60 m from the Lobby.
menginap.foto3: Bungalow 1-14 stands in three rows over the balong.
menginap.foto4: Bungalow Siceeh has two floors, like a house on stilts.
menginap.foto5: Bungalow Arileu sleeps four on two floors.
menginap.foto6: Suite Couple has a private whirlpool, close to the pool.
menginap.foto7: Junior Suite comes with a lesehan lounge and a private whirlpool.
menginap.foto8: Babakan Siluhur 1 is a single compound for 18 guests.
cara.judul: Are you coming as a couple, with family, or with colleagues?
cara.1.label: Couples · weekday
cara.1.isi: The room rate for check-in from Sunday to Friday includes breakfast, swimming pool and Kamar Rendam tickets, tax and service.
cara.1.harga: From Rp1,189,000 per room per night (Kawung, 2 adults)
cara.2.label: Families · weekend
cara.2.isi: The Saturday check-in rate, booked through WhatsApp reservations, includes breakfast, dinner, live music, a fishing package, and swimming pool and Kamar Rendam tickets.
cara.2.harga: From Rp1,989,000 per room per night (Kawung, 2 adults)
cara.3.label: Companies · weekday
cara.3.isi: Your team stays one night in a Bungalow and meets in a function room for up to 350 people. The package includes 3 buffets, 2 coffee breaks, the swimming pool and Kamar Rendam.
cara.3.harga: Rp1,433,000 per person, Twin Share, weekday
cara.catatan: Our reservations team reconfirms the rate when you book.
cara.ruang: Three function rooms, Gambir Wangi, Intan Dewata and Purba Dewata, hold 15 to 350 people.
lokasi.label: At the foot of Mount Guntur
lokasi.judul: Kampung Sumber Alam is in Cipanas, Garut
lokasi.p1: The hot spring water at Kampung Sumber Alam comes from Mount Guntur.
lokasi.p2: Kampung Sumber Alam is at Jl. Raya Cipanas No. 122, Tarogong Kaler, Garut, West Java. For directions, call (0262) 238000.
ulasan.judul: Guests rate Kampung Sumber Alam on Google Maps and Tripadvisor
penutup.judul: Mount Guntur's hot spring water already runs all the way to your room. All that is left is to choose your dates.
